name: cenk-jobs
description: Your job search with Claude: finds and screens job postings under your own rules, writes CVs and cover letters from your own facts, applies in your own Chrome on its own whenever your records answer every question, tracks every application in Google Drive, puts interviews and deadlines in Google Calendar, prepares each hiring step, and shows it all on one private dashboard. Skills: setup (first run), coordinate (your main session), search, plan, apply, prepare (interviews), cheat-sheet (one page beside a call) and schedule (the daily run).
